findings: Original enum codec writes PERFORM_RESPAWN ordinal zero; both actual servers accepted one body 00 on original protocol packet ID and produced actual RESPawn.
Original handlers separately handle won-game/credits and ordinary health<=0, including Hardcore side effects. Common death request does not claim the separate credits path.

Original received spawn pose in these fixtures is Y=65.1, not an invented floor-level receipt. Four released ticks reach predicted dry floor rest at 65.0 and independent RCON verifies the same native endpoint on both versions. The actual received spawn pose at 65.1 remains unchanged.

lightweight_validation: Both real adapters request once from actually decoded health and retain actual RESPawn/new-world origin. Healthy/missing-baseline refusal, clone duplicate refusal, immutable saved record, closure-readable history. Stalled modern writer keeps sync history readable; cancelling waiter leaves owned send, complete frame exactly once and no retry. Modern respawn settling requires owned same-world actual spawn, fresh zero velocity and healthy pose; active input, arbitrary airborne starts and nonzero velocity are refused. Preview does not grant targeting authority.

initial_failures.cause: Test attempted chest activation before native grounded/stationary context; added read-only target admission wait. No respawn request reached server.

Test required received pose Y=65.0 although actual original spawn pose was Y=65.1; preserved original receipt and corrected fixture predicate/legacy pose ID. One actual request and RESPawn received; fresh continuation not completed.
Source-edit assertion stopped before changing predicate but shell proceeded with unchanged trial. Explicitly interrupted known redundant run with SIGINT; original server gracefully stopped.

Actual respawn/healthy pose succeeded at Y=65.1; modern grounded chest admission correctly refused the airborne pose. Added bounded released-only settling from owned actual respawn rather than altering the native fixture or loosening general targeting.

Common respawn/settling/fresh chest succeeded, but harness incorrectly required player position origin Predicted. Public position retains Submitted for dispatched coordinates; model frames separately retain prediction, and received pose stays original. Corrected harness to this existing contract.
Legacy fresh spawn arrived before its existing ground model settled. Added bounded read-only preview admission wait before the one owned neutral run; no mutation retry.

Legacy respawn/neutral run/fresh chest succeeded, but harness assumed modern Submitted origin on the continuously predicted legacy model. Existing legacy position origin is Predicted, with unchanged actual received spawn pose. Corrected pinned-fixture origin check.
